mapper.sql: SELECT t.member_id AS memberId, t.member_no AS memberNo, t.home_store_id AS homeStoreId, hs.store_name AS homeStoreName, t.mobile AS mobile, t.real_name AS realName, t.nickname AS nickname, t.gender AS gender, t.birthday AS birthday, t.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, t.register_source AS registerSource, t.member_status AS memberStatus, t.last_store_id AS lastStoreId, ls.store_name AS lastStoreName, t.last_visit_time AS lastVisitTime, t.remark AS remark, t.create_time AS createTime
FROM fit_member t LEFT JOIN fit_store hs ON hs.store_id = t.home_store_id AND hs.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store ls ON ls.store_id = t.last_store_id AND ls.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0'
